snippet.title: Minishoot’ Adventures – Indie World Showcase 3.3.2026
snippet.description:
Minishoot’ Adventures is available today on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/minishoot-adventures-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Minishoot' Adventures takes the joy of shooter action and combines it with the feeling of going on an incredible quest, as if it was a classic from the 8-bit era. Fight to rescue your friends as you explore a handcrafted world—from a shiny overworld to the deepest caverns—improving your ship and taking down dungeon bosses along the way.

#IndieWorld #MinishootAdventures #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
